These categories are used during crop survey and girdawari data entry
to classify agricultural crops.

Mobile and web survey applications use this list to populate

apis.name: eGirdawari Kharaba Reasons API

This API provides the list of **Kharaba (crop damage) reasons**
used in the eGirdawari agricultural survey system.

The reasons represent various natural disasters, environmental
conditions, and pest-related events that may cause crop damage.
Mobile and web survey applications use this API to populate
dropdown lists when recording crop damage during girdawari surveys.

apis.name: eGirdawari Land Irrigation and Soil Master API

This API provides master data related to **land classification, irrigation sources,
and soil types** used in the eGirdawari system.

The API returns options categorized by the field `fname`, which may represent:
- gairmum : Non-cultivable / miscellaneous land types
- irrigation : Irrigation source types
- soil : Soil classification types

These options are used by mobile and web survey applications
during digital girdawari and land record surveys.

apis.name: eGirdawari Land Use Master API
apis.description:
This API provides the list of land use categories used in the eGirdawari system.
These categories define the type of land utilization within a village or survey unit.

The API is primarily used by mobile and web survey applications during
girdawari surveys to classify non-agricultural or special land areas such
as forests, roads, institutions, and water bodies.

- Auto-generated from backend schema into `src/schema.ts` (77 controllers, ~460 endpoints).
- Strongly typed with TypeScript DTOs.
- Use for ALL
